Done. WeighInReminderWorker + WeighInReminder scheduler (WorkManager periodic, 24 h, anchored to the chosen minute with a 5-min grace so a just-passed slot never near-fires); notification copy per tone rules ("The morning window reads steadiest / whenever you get to it"), tap → wlo://weight/log; POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime-asked on arm (API 33+), denial keeps the toggle off. SettingsStore: weighInReminderEnabled + minuteOfDay (default 07:30) with store test; delayUntilNext unit tests (today/tomorrow/grace/evening anchor). Settings card: toggle + time chips.

Gates: assembleDebug, ktlint, unit suites green. LIVE PROOF on the emulator: toggle armed via adb UI automation → JobScheduler shows the app.wlo WorkManager job with Minimum latency +13h26m = 07:30 tomorrow on the device clock (dumpsys excerpt in evidence), time chips render (06:00–20:00). Screenshot /tmp/wlo-uifix/wlo-0040-reminder.png. Notification-render-at-fire not waited out (fires 07:30 tomorrow) — scheduling math unit-covered + job anchored on-device.
